The '''Nanite Restoration System''' or '''NRS''' was a product developed by [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]] that quickly healed moderate injuries when introduced into the bloodstream of most organic organisms.<ref>{{TORcite|type=item|Adasca Healing Kit}}</ref>
